plugins.name: Panel Updater
plugins.description: Manually update the management center panel (management.html) from the configured panel repository via a browser page.
plugins.author: berry-shake

plugins.name: Model Limiter
plugins.description: Restrict which models specific inbound API keys may use; keys stay in the host api-keys list and rules only subtract model access.
plugins.author: berry-shake

plugins.name: Access Guard
plugins.description: Manages downstream API-key access with model aliases, RPM and budget limits, credential grouping, and CPA-native API key bindings that restrict each key to selected auth-file groups.
plugins.author: origin652 / berry-shake

plugins.name: Autoban
plugins.description: Hold Codex credentials out of the pool after a 429 until the exhausted 5-hour or weekly window resets, with a status page to put them back manually.
plugins.author: ysxk / berry-shake

plugins.name: Wokey
plugins.description: Use Wokey API keys as auth files: registers Wokey's model catalog (or a selected subset) with a wokey/ prefix by default, forwards OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages natively, shows each key's 24h / 7d / 30d spend as balance bars in the quota panel, and adds a page to manage keys, models, balances and per-key egress proxies, with a request log kept on disk.
plugins.author: berry-shake

plugins.name: Ollama
plugins.description: Use Ollama Cloud API keys as auth files: registers Ollama's cloud models (or a selected subset) with context length and vision / tools / thinking capabilities under an ollama/ prefix by default, forwards OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages natively, shows the account's plan credit, purchased credit and 24h / 7d / 30d usage in the quota panel, and adds a page to manage keys, models, balances and per-key egress proxies, with a request log kept on disk.
plugins.author: berry-shake

plugins.name: OpenCode
plugins.description: Use OpenCode Console API keys (OpenCode Go or pay-as-you-go Zen) as auth files: registers OpenCode's models (or a selected subset) with context length, max output, input kinds, tools and reasoning efforts under an opencode/ prefix by default, forwards OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages (plus count_tokens) with the session header Go requires, shows the workspace's Go 5-hour / weekly / monthly usage in the quota panel, and adds a page to manage keys, models, prices, Go usage and per-key egress proxies, with a request log kept on disk.
plugins.author: berry-shake
